Name: Yandere Morris
Author: totoroo678678
Description:
# 🎃 Yandere Morris Nightmare — Version 2.0.0 (The Slasher Update)

The cozy life in Stardew Valley is over. Your innocent romance with Morris has mutated into a deep, inescapable psychological survival horror. This is a complete, hardcore C# code rebuild that transforms the valley into a real slasher film in the spirit of *The Skeleton Key*. You can try to fight, you can try to hide, but the trap has already snapped shut...

---

## 💥 KEY FEATURES

 1. Real Kidnapping & Captivity Mechanics
The streets are no longer safe at night. If you stay outdoors **after 10:00 PM**, a terrifying stalker event will trigger. Morris will hunt you down from behind, knock you out, and drag you into the pitch-black JojaMart. You will be locked inside until 6:00 AM under an electric forcefield.
* *Warning:* Attempting to smash the locked doors or bypass the barrier will electrocute you, draining your health!

🍲 2. The Luau Tragedy (Summer 11)
The beach is unsettlingly quiet during the summer festival. Alex is missing, but Morris has been lingering around the soup pot all day with a wide, smug grin. Tasting the Governor's soup will reveal a blood-stained green fabric with a '55' emblem at the bottom. Morris will watch you from the crowd, whispering: *'Shh... it tastes good, doesn't it?'*

🥚 3. The Egg Festival Sabotage (Spring 13)
The town square festival game begins, but the spots of the local bachelors are completely empty. A muffled thud echoes from behind the town hall, instantly drowned out by the festive music. Morris's guards will politely but firmly hold you by the shoulders, making sure you don't move an inch.

 🏪 4. Corporate Store Takeover
Rivals and merchants will randomly vanish from the game world. Once Pierre disappears, his family will flee to the Wizard's Tower in sheer panic. Morris will personally occupy Pierre's empty, dark counter, threatening your life if you refuse to sign the Joja contract and buy his seeds.

👁️ 5. The Herobrine Stalker Effect
A creepy ghost silhouette of Morris will randomly spawn in foggy areas, watching your movements from a distance. If you try to get closer to inspect him, a dark flash will blind you, and he will instantly dissolve into the air, leaving only the faint echo of steps.

 ⚙️ 6. Full GMCM Config Support
No more editing config files manually! You can now configure the apocalypse directly in the game options menu via Generic Mod Config Menu:
* Toggle between **Easy, Hard, UltraHard, or Nightmare** stalker modes.
* Turn the Herobrine Stalker effect ON or OFF with a single click.

---

## 🌍 GLOBAL LOCALIZATION (i18n)
Thanks to the new independent text engine, the mod features 68 unique, randomly generated psychological horror phrases, fully translated without any text bugs for:
English (default)
Russian (Русский)
German (Deutsch)
French (Français)
Spanish (Español)
Italian  (Italiano)
Japanese  (日本語)
Korean  (한국어)
Turkish  (Türkçe)


 🛠️ INSTALLATION
1. Make sure you have **SMAPI** and **Generic Mod Config Menu** installed.
2. Download this mod and unpack the ZIP archive into your `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder.
3. Launch the game via `StardewModdingAPI.exe` and prepare to face your nightmare.
